  <section class="bs-laser-project-notes" aria-labelledby="headphone-design-title">
    <p class="bs-laser-kicker">Design intent</p>
    <h2 id="headphone-design-title">A flat sheet becomes a stable stand</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>The SVG uses interlocking profiles rather than glue or separate hardware.</li>
      <li>The curved top supports the headphone band while the base spreads the load on the desk.</li>
      <li>The source design was made for a Logitech G533 headset, so other headsets should be checked for band width, ear-cup clearance and centre of mass.</li>
      <li>The SVG canvas is approximately 280.26 × 252.01 mm.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section class="bs-laser-project-warning" aria-labelledby="headphone-fit-title">
    <p class="bs-laser-kicker">Fit before a full cut</p>
    <h2 id="headphone-fit-title">“3 mm” is a design assumption, not a measured sheet</h2>
    <p>The original source describes tight slots for 3.0 mm Baltic birch and no glue. Measure the actual plywood with callipers and cut a slot coupon before the full layout. Kerf, finish and sheet variation can turn a tight press fit into a loose joint or a split part.</p>
    <p>The SVG contains multiple operation colours exported from Fusion 360. Confirm the intended cut order and map every colour in the local laser software before fabrication.</p>
  </section>
